text: The room was spotless and the bathroom smelled fresh. Best cleanliness I have seen in this price range.
WiFi was painfully slow. Could not even join a video call from the room.
Staff at the front desk were rude and refused to help with an early check-in.
Breakfast buffet had poor variety but the omelette station was good.
AC was not cooling at all. We had to sleep with the window open in summer.
Too much road noise at night. Could hear trucks until 2am.
Great location, walking distance to the beach and the market.
Overpriced for what you get. The room was tiny for the rate they charge.
Clean rooms, friendly staff, and the AC worked perfectly. Highly recommend.
Food was average. WiFi kept disconnecting every few minutes.
AC bilkul kaam nahi kar raha tha, raat bhar neend udd gayi.
Room theek tha but bathroom mein gandi smell aa rahi thi.
Staff bahut helpful the, luggage room par free mein rakha.
WiFi ka speed bahut slow tha, video call bhi nahi ho paya.
Hotel ka location perfect hai, station se 5 minute ki doori par.
Khana average tha, dinner mein options kam the.
Price ke hisaab se theek hai, zyada ummeed mat rakho.
Road ke shor se neend nahi aayi, AC on karke soye.
The reception staff arranged a cab at midnight without any fuss. Very polite people.
Moss and mould in the bathroom corner. Housekeeping missed it for three days.
Complimentary breakfast was surprisingly good for a budget hotel.
AC made a loud grinding noise all night but at least it cooled the room.
Noisy bar downstairs until late. Ask for a room on a higher floor.
Five minutes from the lake and the ferry ghat. Perfect for tourists.
Charged extra for breakfast that was already included in the package. Not worth the money.
WiFi worked fine in the lobby but died in the rooms on the third floor.
Housekeeping changed the sheets every day and left a nice note. Clean and cared for.
Restaurant staff forgot our order twice and the manager did not apologise.
AC worked great, room was cool even in the afternoon heat.
Value for money near the bus stand. Clean beds and working AC.
Kitchen ka khana theek tha, staff ne jaldi serve kiya.
Bathroom mein garam paani nahi aaya subah. Staff ne turant check kiya.
Hotel city centre mein hai, sab jagah easily pahunch sakte ho.
Noise from the construction site started at 7am. Management offered no discount.
The wifi password kept changing and no one at the desk knew the new one.
Spacious room, clean linen, and the AC kept the temperature just right.
Room rate was low but everything else was extra. Ended up spending more than a better hotel.
Local language menu was not available and the waiter looked confused when we asked in Hindi.
Perfect base for a weekend trip. Quiet street, clean rooms, helpful host.
Geyser was broken, WiFi was dead, and the front desk said both were normal for the season.
